basis: PMID 32086342 / PMC7299809 (Clin Cancer Res 2020, doi 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-19-2706), Results: 'We generated a tissue microarray (TMA) of 32 patient-matched NF/PNF and MPNST pairs that included 3 ANNUBPs from 12 NF1 patients cared for at the Iowa NF Clinic'; the RNA-seq was run on FFPE cores adjacent to those TMA cores, so it is the same cohort. Methods add the provenance (University of Iowa Pathology, IRB 201507708) and the results section is headed 'in NF1 patient specimens'.
caveat: Clinical NF1 diagnosis at an NF clinic, not per-patient germline sequencing: the word 'germline' does not appear in the paper and no mutation table is reported.
